en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with the results of research in the field of plant biotechnology through external experts from practice and universities. Students will get an idea of ​​the practical use of plant biotechnology in the Czech Republic, but also in the world.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to plant biotechnology (allowance 2/0)2.Plant biotechnology in agriculture (allowance 6/0)3.Plant biotechnology in horticulture (allowance 4/0)4.Plant biotechnology in forestry (allowance 4/0)5.Plant biotechnology in environmental protection (allowance 4/0)6.Biotechnology of plants in the food industry (allowance 2/0)7.Plant biotechnology in pharmacy (allowance 2/0)8.Defense of seminar theses (allowance 4/0)
